abstract: Clinical information and histopathologic material for 165 patients with hydatidiform mole referred to the John I. Brewer Trophoblastic Disease Center of Northwestern University Medical School during one year were reviewed in order to identify characteristics more likely to be associated with the development of gestational trophoblastic tumors. Twenty-nine patients (18%) required chemotherapy for invasive mole or choriocarcinoma. Patients with uterine enlargement beyond that expected for dates and patients with ovarian theca-lutein cysts were much more likely to require treatment after molar evacuation (47% vs. 18% and 40% vs. 16%, respectively). There was no correlation between the initial human chorionic gonadotropin level, gestational age, uterine size per se, maternal age or gravidity and the subsequent clinical course. Histologically, the following factors were associated with an increased incidence of postmolar gestational trophoblastic tumor: (1) progressive nuclear atypia (26.7% if atypia present vs. 40% if absent); (2) necrosis and hemorrhage (39.1% if extensive vs. 12.8% if limited); (3) decreased trophoblast maturation (48% if less than 20% mature vs. 8.7% if greater than or equal to 20% mature); (4) trophoblast proliferation (50% if marked vs. 13.9% if limited); (5) increased ratio of cytotrophoblast to syncytium (33.3% if greater than 1 vs. 6.4% if less than 1); and (6) absence of Nitabuch's layer (21.4% if absent vs. 11.6% if present). Hydatidiform moles which demonstrate clinical or histopathologic evidence of excessively abnormal proliferative activity, as indicated by these features, are more likely to develop invasive mole or choriocarcinoma and should be considered for prophylactic chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: ノースウェスタン大学医学部のJohn I. Brewer絨毛性疾患センターに1年間に紹介された胞状奇胎患者165例の臨床情報と組織病理学的材料を検討し、胞状奇胎後の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の発生と関連する特徴を明らかにすることを目的とした。29例(18%)が侵入奇胎または絨毛癌のために化学療法を必要とした。妊娠週数に比べて子宮が過大な患者、および卵巣黄胞嚢胞のあった患者は、奇胎除去後に治療を要する頻度がそれぞれ47%対18%、40%対16%と著しく高かった。初期のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値、妊娠週数、子宮の大きさそのもの、母体年齢、妊娠回数と、その後の臨床経過との間には相関はみられなかった。組織学的には、以下の因子が胞状奇胎後の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の発生率上昇と関連していた:(1)進行性の核異型(異型あり26.7%、なし40%);(2)壊死と出血(著明な場合39.1%、軽度の場合12.8%);(3)栄養膜の成熟低下(成熟度20%未満で48%、20%以上で8.7%);(4)栄養膜の増殖(著明な場合50%、軽度の場合13.9%);(5)細胞性栄養膜細胞と合胞体の比(1超で33.3%、1未満で6.4%);(6)Nitabuch層の欠如(欠如で21.4%、存在で11.6%)。これらの所見から異常な増殖活性が臨床的または組織学的に示された胞状奇胎は、侵入奇胎や絨毛癌へ進展する可能性が高く、予防的化学療法の対象として考慮すべきである。
